results.name: The Forbidden Lust of a Frigid Girl
results.description: June, a 22-year-old asocial girl, escapes reality through adult websites and is unable to share her desires in relationships, leading to self-sabotage. But when she meets Poppy, her elegant new co-worker, her intimate world is shaken. As attraction grows, June must confront her fears. Will she finally open up or push love away once again?
